Property Overview

Available 1 February 2026

Positioned within the prestigious Glades Office Park, this prominent stand-alone building offers an exceptional environment for a corporate headquarters seeking high-quality, secure premises with complete operational independence.

The property operates strictly under a Gross Lease and includes additional service costs, so the facilities and grounds are maintained to corporate standards. Substantial dedicated parking allocations (50 total bays) cater to both client-facing operations and core staff needs.

A Secure & Resilient Workplace:

  • Backup Generator to keep the building running during power outages.
  • Backup Water Supply protecting against local infrastructure interruptions.
  • Park Security providing elite access control and physical asset protection.
